title: 040 regime-transition target (research R11, R12): a causal bear->bull / bull->bear label at 1, 3 and 7 days, pair and BTC level; its stand-in screen; trading arms only for passing cells
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test. Committed before any transition label is built.

definition.z: z_L(t) = log(close_t / SMA_L(t)) / (sigma(t) * sqrt(L)); SMA over L bars (min_periods L); sigma = trailing std of 1-bar log returns over sigma_window bars (min_periods sigma_min_periods)
definition.state: BULL if z >= +deadband, BEAR if z <= -deadband, else SIDEWAYS (L = H)
definition.label: UP if S_H(t) != BULL and S_H(t+H) == BULL; DOWN if S_H(t) != BEAR and S_H(t+H) == BEAR; NaN where either end is unknown

grid.note: 96/288/672 bars = 1/3/7 days at 15m; btc = BTC's close joined by date, predicted on every pair's rows

rows: tradeable bars only (037 cache meta:data_ok and volume > 0) of the 10 screen pairs; BTC is an input and the btc-level label source, not a scored pair

causality.rule: z_L and the state from every prefix equal the full series' on the overlap (L in {H, H/4}); the label from a prefix ending at a cut equals the full label for t <= cut-H and is NaN after; every stand-in input has an explicit PASS in 037's truncation tables. Any mismatch: STOP (no screen runs).

stand_in.model: sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier, one-vs-rest per cell (UP vs rest, DOWN vs rest)
stand_in.btc: BTC's raw8 (btc: prefix) joined by date
stand_in.state_inputs: z_L of the pair's close and of BTC's close for each state length (causal; the trailing-trend baseline's information is inside the model, so the model must beat it with something else)
stand_in.fit: each fold: rows with date < test_start - tail_days - H bars (purge H); hourly subsample (minute == 0)
stand_in.tail: rows in [test_start - tail_days, test_start - H bars): out-of-sample predictions, the arms' percentile source

baselines.trailing_trend: AUC of z_{H/4}(t) of the same level (sign-flipped for DOWN): 'the trend has already turned'

screen_rule.margin: AUC - max(0.5, trailing-trend AUC), pooled per half over the half's test windows
screen_rule.events: run starts of the positive label per pair
screen_rule.proxy: top decile of each fold's scored test bars, pooled per half: UP -> mean forward H-bar log return of the pair, in bp, minus 30 > 0; DOWN -> top-decile mean minus all-bar mean <= -30
screen_rule.pass: margin >= 0.02 in BOTH halves AND events >= 200 in both halves AND the proxy passes in both halves
screen_rule.selection: per direction, the passing cell with the largest late-half margin goes forward to the arms

tr_gate.use: cs_aro's book skips an entry while P(DOWN, selected cell) >= the 80th percentile of that fold's tail predictions

tr_scale.use: cs_aro's stake x1.333 when P(UP) >= tail p80, x0.667 when P(DOWN) >= tail p80 (both: unchanged)

tr_long.use: standalone long entry when P(UP) >= tail p99, on st_g24_rev's exit stack; PASS if pooled pp > 0 in both halves AND the bootstrap 95% CI of the per-trade mean pp (seed 0) excludes 0; st_g24_rev reported

tr_exit.use: cs_aro closes an open trade at the first candle with P(DOWN) >= tail p90

head_version: only if a stand-in cell passes: <M>_trh retargets the regime head with that cell's label (UP/NONE/DOWN, task weight 1); screened with the same rule; if its AUC is within 0.01 of the stand-in's in both halves its tables replace the stand-in's in the passing arms
seeds: any PASS is re-run with the HGB re-fit at random_state 1
seen_before: 037: regime-style targets beat persistence only at 48/288 bars; price-level/calendar columns produced spurious winners (excluded here: inputs are the deployed model's)
NNMT's regime label is a centred-mean state (not used here)
no transition label has been built or scored before this commit
